L17: > Abstract:A recent manuscript produced by Claude under the direction of Levent Alpöge constructs a 1-parameter family of compact complex threefolds diffeomorphic to $S^6$. Our goal is to describe the geometric ideas behind the construction, give a self-contained proof, and remark on possible future research directions.
